admission.justification: Root admission and absent-selector refusal prevent false emptiness; the bounded summary and full selected comparison report prevent false completeness; the separately recorded capture disclosure prevents a falsely side-effect-free reading. These are distinct member duties, not one path-based group.

guarantee: For the declared converted knowledge_diff requests, root admission and an absent-selector refusal prevent a falsely empty comparison. The bounded answer names the compared trees, change counts, decision-asking records up to the list bound and the caller-readable report. The report carries the complete selected mechanical comparison produced by the unchanged comparison function, including its existing per-file patch-cut flags; answer-level patch omission is replaced by report location and counts, not presented as a complete inline comparison. Within the recorded capture obligation's scope, loose-object capture remains disclosed. This is a mechanical file comparison, not a semantic verdict or canonical-dataset comparison. A report write refusal names its reason rather than returning a partial comparison.
title: Explicit scope and limits of mechanical knowledge diff
